summary: Same converged whole-branch autoreview pass, performance lens. No performance findings in any round. The added work per permission decision is one in-memory Map lookup at request processing and, for scheduled grants only, one indexed getJobById at grant time (a rare, human-paced event). Grant resolution adds a personId equality filter on already-loaded bindings; no new queries on the hot turn path. Migration adds one nullable column and a unique index (NULLS NOT DISTINCT) on a small table.
